hooks.command: cat data/job_tracker.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); active=[j for j in d.get('jobs',[]) if j.get('status') not in ['rejected','withdrawn']]; print(f'📊 Active applications: {len(active)} | Total tracked: {len(d.get(\"jobs\",[]))}')" 2>/dev/null || echo '📋 Job tracker not initialized yet.
